name: Moonwell Comptroller (Unitroller)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Unitroller.admin() is a TemporalGovernor whose only trusted Wormhole sender is one Ethereum address, Moonwell’s MultichainGovernor V2 proxy, and it executes that sender’s messages after a 1-day delay. A 3-of-5 guardian Safe can pause once and then fast-track a valid message past that delay.
narrative.tag: $14.0M Base TVL, guardian can fast-track past the delay
narrative.detail: The scorer caps the timelock score at 50 for that guardian path, and the Ethereum-side governor (quorum, proxy admin) and Wormhole’s own guardian set were not verified by this Base-only scorer. In the Comptroller source the pauseGuardian (3-of-5 Safe) can only pause mint, borrow, transfer and seize, with unpausing reserved to the admin, and the borrow and supply cap guardian (2-of-4 Safe) can only set market caps, both disclosed but not scored. crossExposureScore 100 means not computed for this target, not a confirmed clean result.
